caption:
Your brain has two processing modes: abstract (why) and concrete (what). Overthinking is abstract mode running without a switch. One rewritten question flips it.

The Mode Switch is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.

Save this for the next loop that understanding can't break. Send it to someone who analyzes everything but changes nothing.
